I've been wanting to get it done for years; my skin is okay but there's some faint scarring left over from those occasional teen spots and such, and some small-but-visible pores in my t-zone; nothing too bad, and I go out without makeup and look fine, but it would be nice to have really smooth skin. I also used to use baking soda as an exfoliant--it's really gentle and if your skin is prone to acid-sensitivity it can be a big help to calm that down.
